entities.name: UniProt Q47KG0 FluC1
observations: Exact sequence match (120 aa) to reviewed Thermobifida fusca FluC 1, a fluoride-specific ion channel; annotated to reduce intracellular fluoride toxicity.
Annotated as a cell-membrane multipass protein; GO:0005886, GO:0062054, GO:0140114.
Sequence-derived estimates: mass 12,014 Da, pI 9.04, GRAVY 0.878; Pfam CRCB (PF02537.22) at residues 4–112.
